decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Unclear referent. 'einander so gleich und ungleich' compares the powers, means and results of one language with those of another; the English 'its powers, means and results resemble and differ from one another' can be read as comparing powers with means with results. The possessive 'its' is also an addition.
decision.resolution: Accepted: remove its and make the comparison from language to language explicit; powers are not being compared with means or results as different categories.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'nun' is rendered 'therefore', which adds an inferential link the German does not assert.
decision.resolution: Accepted: now replaces therefore, avoiding an unnecessarily explicit deduction.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'bedingt' is rendered 'determined', the word used everywhere else for 'bestimmt'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: conditioned retains the local bedingt/bestimmt difference.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'in seinem ganzen Zusammenwirken' becomes 'in its full interaction'. 'Interaction' is the rendering of 'Wechselwirkung' elsewhere (23, 39, 54), and 'Zusammenwirken' becomes 'cooperation' in p30:s4. The English also leaves it unclear what interacts with what.
decision.resolution: Partly accepted: combined operation as a whole clarifies Zusammenwirken and avoids the Wechselwirkung rendering interaction. A compulsory invariant noun is not imposed:17 concerns the procedure’s combined operation,30 combined social action upon language.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Inconsistent rendering of one concept. 'Empfindungsvermögen' is 'capacity for ... feeling' here but 'faculty of sensation' in p36:s4. More broadly, 'Empfindung/empfinden' alternates between 'sensation' (p23:s1, p26:s1, p36:s4) and 'feeling' (p19:s1, p27:s2, p31:s6, p39:s12, p49:s5, p49:s7, p50:s5, p50:s7), where it merges with 'Gefühl' = 'feeling'.
decision.resolution: Not adopted as a universal substitution. The checked uses contrast thinking/feeling in19, but animal sensory responsiveness in23/26/36. Sensation in all uses would impose a narrower bodily concept on the former. The conditional termbase permits feeling/sensation; the guide exposes the overlapping Gefühl/Empfindung renderings.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'wirkt ... wieder bestimmend auf den Geist zurück' is rendered 'in turn acts upon and determines the mind'. This drops the 'acts back' wording used for 'zurückwirken' everywhere else (p19:s2, p20:s7, p34:s1, p40:s4, p42:s4).
decision.resolution: Accepted: restore acts back upon the mind, determining it, making the recurring feedback relation explicit.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Three linked points, the first two source ambiguities that the English resolves silently. (1) The subject of 'begründet' is ambiguous: 'sie' (intellectual activity) or 'er' (the sound now become articulated). The English assigns it to intellectual activity; the nearer subject is the sound. (2) The parenthesis '(wenn es möglich wäre, einen Anfang aller Sprache zu denken)' stands between 'Laut' and 'begründet' and most naturally qualifies the founding of a domain of sounds. The English encloses it in dashes with the becoming-articulated clause, shifting its scope. (3) 'Ton ... wird zum articulirten Laut' becomes 'sound becomes articulated sound'; the Ton/Laut step is carried only by the adjective.
decision.resolution: Partly accepted: move the hypothetical condition to the establishment clause and remove the dash enclosure that confined it to articulation. Retain intellectual activity as subject of establishes, while a new local note records articulated sound as the alternative subject. Sound/articulated sound carries the contextual Ton/Laut distinction without inventing an invariant tone/speech-sound lexicon.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'der Form seines Wirkens' becomes 'the form of its own activity'. 'Its' is ambiguous in English between mind and sound, and 'Wirken' is rendered 'activity', the standing equivalent of 'Thätigkeit' ('Wirken' is 'operation' in heading:i1, p51:s2 and p52:s9).
decision.resolution: Accepted: identify the mind as possessor of the operation; operation keeps Wirken visible without a rigid distinction from all activity.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'errathen lernen' is rendered 'learn to infer'.
decision.resolution: Accepted in substance: learn to guess replaces infer. Guess is ordinary English for errathen here; divine could suggest a supernatural faculty not asserted in the passage.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Attachment is unclear: in '... in place of what is missing, of which we have no conception' the relative clause can attach to 'what is missing' rather than to the sensory 'something'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: repeat something before of which to attach the unknown sensory content correctly.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'von dem Gedanken bestimmten Organe' is rendered 'organs directed by thought'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: organs determined by thought restores the locally important determining relation.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Drang des Gedanken nach Aeusserung' becomes 'urge towards expression'. 'Expression' is the rendering of 'Ausdruck', and 'Aeusserung' is 'utterance' in p48:s5.
decision.resolution: Accepted: utterance carries the outward expression in this context and preserves the connection with the later utterance discussion.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'ein reines Beschauen' is rendered 'the mere contemplation'.
decision.resolution: Not adopted: mere contemplation accurately denies representation as exclusively receptive contemplation in the following contrast. Pure beholding would be less idiomatic and would not establish a new source distinction. The following synthetic activity remains explicit.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'nur Ideen mit den Tönen verbindend' becomes 'only with ideas joined to sounds'. The active participle is lost and 'Tönen' loses its musical sense in a clause about singing.
decision.resolution: Accepted: retain an active joining of ideas to tones in the singing comparison. Only one that qualifies the kind of singing creature; it is not an independent assertion that no other species associates anything with sound.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Der viel wesentlichere Entstehungsgrund' is rendered with an indefinite article, 'A far more essential cause'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: restore The far more essential cause, retaining the definite contrast with assistance.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'more or less ringing devoid of ideas' is hard to parse. 'Schmettern' is also 'ringing out' in p26:s1 but 'resounding' in p28:s4.
decision.resolution: Accepted for clarity: a greater or lesser amount of ringing out devoid of ideas avoids attaching more or less to the absence of ideas. No invariant translation of all Schmettern/geräusch combinations is imposed across different grammatical contexts.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'spricht sie sich nur selbst vor dem Ohre aus' becomes 'only by speaking to the ear'. The restriction 'nur selbst' (only the language itself, as against any description) is moved onto the manner.
decision.resolution: Accepted: only the language itself, sounding before the ear restores the contrast with descriptive classification.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'wenn auch die fortschreitende Entwicklung viel abschliesst' is rendered 'brings much to completion'. 'Abschliessen' is ambiguous (complete, conclude, or close off). In a concessive clause set against 'something fixed' remaining, 'closes off' fits at least as well.
decision.resolution: Partly accepted: brings much to a close leaves completion/closing off less narrowly decided. The enlarged scan confirms abschliesst; the local note records both senses and rejects silent substitution of a wear-away verb. The source ambiguity remains unresolved.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'das Grosse, Geistige, Vorherrschende' becomes 'great, intellectual and predominant'. 'Geistig' is 'mental' almost everywhere else, and 'intellectual' is the equivalent of 'intellectuell'. The same variant occurs in p37:s9 ('geistigsten Gebrauche' as 'most intellectual use').
decision.resolution: Not adopted as an invariant mental/intellectual division. The most geistig use in literature and the great/geistig contrast can naturally be intellectual in English. The source itself also uses intellectuell; the guide records overlap rather than inventing two exclusive faculties. Neither occurrence changes the main claim.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Addition. The German has 'einmal dass ..., dass ...' with no second marker; the English supplies 'and second'.
decision.resolution: Retained as a disclosed syntactic completion in the apparatus: the source expressly announces twofold and Beides follows. Supplying second creates no third element; square brackets are reserved here for actual printed supplementation, with translator interpretation recorded separately.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'das gesellige Zusammenwirken auf sie' is rendered 'the social cooperation acting upon language'. See F04: 'Zusammenwirken' has two different renderings.
decision.resolution: Partly accepted with F04: greater and more animated combined social action preserves the combined-action relation and bewegter without suggesting that an impersonal process is a consciously planned cooperation.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Es ist nur uns unmöglich' is rendered 'It is simply impossible for us'. Adversative 'nur' is turned into an intensifier.
decision.resolution: Accepted: Yet makes nur adversative rather than an intensifier of impossibility.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'alles Sprechen ist auf Anrede und Erwiederung gestellt' is rendered 'directed towards address and reply'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: rests on address and reply preserves the structural basis instead of turning it into an aim.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Terminology. 'Gegenstand' is 'thing' here, to keep it apart from 'Object' in the same sentence, but 'object' everywhere else (p31:s14, p36:s2, p39:s2–s7, s11–s12), where it merges with 'Object' = 'object'.
decision.resolution: Not adopted as a universal thing/object mapping. Gegenstand in31:s14 includes I/he, so it is not invariably an external physical thing, nor does Object alone establish a separate ontological kind. Retain the local distinction in31:s11 and clarify the external referent in39:s7 (F35); a guide entry explains the contextual choice and overlap.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Omission: 'gewährt ihm' loses its dative, giving 'provides conviction and stimulation'. The colon also turns the second clause into a gloss on the first.
decision.resolution: Accepted: restore human beings as beneficiaries and the semicolon, avoiding a new explanatory relation.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Anregung der Sprachkraft' becomes 'activation'; 'Anregung' is 'stimulation' in p32:s1, and 'anregen' is 'activate' in p36:s4 and p36:s12. The expansion 'understanding activates its inward receptivity, as speaking activates its outward activity' also over-resolves an elliptical clause.
decision.resolution: Accepted in substance: stimulation of the power in its inward receptivity/outward activity avoids saying that receptivity itself is activated. Different inflections of anregen remain readable in their contexts; there is no demonstrated new mechanism requiring one invariant English verb.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Stufen' is 'stages' here but 'levels' in p50:s11 and p50:s14, which describe the same ladder of individualization.
decision.resolution: Accepted: levels in33 and50 keeps the resumed gradation visible.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'wieder in einander begriffenen' is rendered 'mutually nested'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: each in turn contained within another removes the misleading mutual nesting.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'wie denn keine metaphysische ... Untersuchung' is made a new causal sentence beginning 'For ...'. 'Lead beyond the endpoint' also slightly recasts 'weiter als an das Ende ... zu leiten'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: just as, indeed restores the confirming comparison instead of asserting a new causal proof.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: (1) The parenthesis 'nicht der an sich, sondern auch der ...' has no 'bloss'; the English normalizes it to 'not just ... but also'. (2) 'Menschengeschlecht' is 'humanity' here and in p41:s4, p44:s2, p46:s1, p48:s5, but 'human race' in p30:s2, p40:s6, p42:s3, while 'Menschheit' is also 'humanity' (p40:s2, p47:s5, p53:s1).
decision.resolution: Partly accepted: keep the inclusive reading and disclose the missing only in the existing local note, without adding brackets indistinguishable from1906 supplements. Do not force Menschengeschlecht and Menschheit into an invariant human-race/humanity opposition; the words can overlap, while the local concept of humanity in47 remains explicit.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Modality: 'es wäre möglich, dass ... so verführe' is rendered with the indicative, 'it is possible that ... proceeds'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: it might be keeps the speculative modality rather than an ordinary indicative possibility.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Lost image: 'vom Mutterschoosse in jedes fremde versetzt' becomes 'taken from birth and placed among any foreign people'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: restore the mother’s-lap image instead of reducing it to a precise temporal expression from birth. The claim remains about placement among another people, without specifying a measured age.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Unclear English: 'the even predominant power of the surrounding sounds'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: power—indeed, the predominant power makes the concession readable.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'ihre ursprüngliche Bestimmung zu einer andren Sprache ... verrückt' is rendered 'their original determination for another language had been ... displaced'. 'Bestimmung' here means vocation or destination, not 'determination'. The attachment of 'zu einer andren Sprache' is ambiguous: 'destined for another language' or 'shifted onto another language'. The English is hard to understand on either reading. 'Geistigsten' as 'most intellectual' is covered in F19.
decision.resolution: Accepted for clarity, with an explicit choice of attachment: they had originally been destined for another language, but this destiny had been accidentally altered. The alternative attachment, a destiny shifted onto another language, remains in the linked decision and reader note; neither is claimed uniquely established.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Object' and 'Gegenstand' both become 'object' in one sentence: 'the word ... makes itself an object confronting the soul' and 'the impression of the object'. The reader cannot tell that the first is the word as Object and the second the external thing.
decision.resolution: Partly accepted: the impression of the external object distinguishes it from the word made an object for the soul. A global things/objects partition would overread the varied Gegenstand uses; see F24 and the new guide.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Misplaced apposition. In 'But language is produced from speaking—a stock of words and a system of rules—' the gloss attaches to 'speaking' in English, though in German it defines 'die Sprache'. The reflexive 'erzeugt sich' is also flattened to a passive.
decision.resolution: Accepted: from speaking there arises language—a stock of words and a system of rules—which grows puts the defining apposition next to language. Arises preserves the reflexive emergence without making language a separate self-creating agent.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'sie gerade ebenso zum Object zu machen' is rendered 'making it an object in precisely the same way'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: just as much an object preserves the equal-degree opposition to passing wholly into the subject.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'die Kraft des Einzelnen gegen die Macht der Sprache' gives 'power' for both nouns.
decision.resolution: Not adopted as an invariant force/might scheme. Kraft and Macht describe the two bearers’ powers here; their relation is explicit in the English. The glossary exposes the German nouns and their contextual overlap rather than introducing an unsupported mechanism or category for each.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'die sich nur in vielen der Beobachtung entzieht' is elliptical: 'in vielen' has no noun. The English supplies 'cases'; given the next sentence, 'languages' is also possible.
decision.resolution: Retained, with the ellipsis and generations/languages alternatives explicitly recorded in the existing42:s4 choice. Cases supplies the least restrictive English noun. A printed reader bracket would misleadingly resemble a source supplement.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'theils geringer, theils schwieriger wahrzunehmen' is rendered 'both smaller and harder to perceive'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: in part smaller, in part harder to perceive leaves the distribution open instead of asserting that both always hold together.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Stamm' is 'tribe' here but 'stock' in p29:s6 ('Stämme'), in 'Stammartiges' (p29:s5, p37:s6) and in 'Völkerstamm' (p33:s6, p46:s6).
decision.resolution: Accepted: stock replaces tribe in43:s3, avoiding a gratuitous change of group label within the descent/contact argument.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'nach einer Stammsprache suchen lässt' is rendered 'a search for a single ancestral language'. 'Single' is an interpretive addition.
decision.resolution: Accepted: remove single; the preceding several languages and the contrast with different materials already carry the inference.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Scope of 'nur ... erst'. The English 'only at a certain point, after formation is complete' ties 'only' to the point; the German has adversative 'nur' plus 'erst nach vollendeter Bildung'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: however and visible at a certain point only after formation is complete restore the adversative and temporal restriction. Point/respect remains an unresolved local alternative in the audit record; no general chronological threshold is added.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Note apparatus. (1) Neither the supplied German nor the English of p43:s5 shows the note anchor. In the uncorrected background text the asterisk follows 'auf die Sprachen'; I used this only as background, not as a governing reading. (2) The square brackets in 'S. [43.]' are an editorial supplement in the 1906 edition, and the reader should be told so. (3) The title needs italics, and 'Mr' for 'Herr' is a domestication.
decision.resolution: Anchor confirmed from the checked print, not just OCR: after Sprachen in43:s5. The reader callout follows descent for languages, title is italicized, and the prelude explains that [43.] is printed supplementation. Mr translates Herr normally; retaining Herr adds no information. The complete note is attributed to Humboldt; Klaproth’s page itself is not newly verified.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'auf welches sie sich vereinigen' is rendered 'upon which they converge'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: on which they agree preserves the reflexive convergence/agreement relation without turning it into impersonal drift.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: (1) 'unzeitiger Gleichnisse' as 'inopportune analogies': 'Gleichniss' is a simile or figurative comparison, and 'analogy' is the rendering of 'Analogie' (p39:s8, p48:s10). (2) 'die übrigens gar nicht die Anmassung der Neuheit mit sich führt' as 'It makes no claim to novelty' drops 'übrigens' and softens 'Anmassung'. (3) The means clause 'mit Abschneidung ...' is turned into a first co-ordinate aim.
decision.resolution: Accepted in substance: untimely comparisons avoids confusing Gleichnisse with the recurring Analogie; moreover/no pretension and the by-means clause are restored. A deliberate pun on temporal succession is plausible but not established and is not asserted in a reader note.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Syntax. 'und aller Unterschied der Racen weder ... aufhebt' is verb-final and still depends on 'wie'; the English can be read as a new independent assertion.
decision.resolution: Accepted: remove the comma that could detach racial differences from the comparison. Preserve the historical terminology and the human-unity assertion without modern endorsement.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Modality: the conditional 'wenn man ... zerlegt, ... bringt, ... vergleicht, und immer so fortfährt' is rendered as a requirement ('One must divide ... and one must continue').
decision.resolution: Accepted: replace must by the conditional if-chain. The source describes how a demonstration can be made, not an additional obligation.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'is easier to intuit in a foreign one' can be read as 'easier in a foreign language than in one's own'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: one more readily intuits avoids the mistaken comparison that foreign-language insight is easier than native-language insight.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Unidiomatic and unclear: 'No one thinks exactly what another does at a word'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: in using a word is intelligible English for the contextual bei dem Wort without restricting it solely to hearing.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'unter der Allgemeinheit des Begriffs und der Empfindung' is rendered 'generality of concept and feeling', immediately after 'Gedanken und Gefühlen' as 'thoughts and feelings' in p50:s6.
decision.resolution: Not adopted as a mechanical sensation substitution. The contrast in50 concerns the generality and individual differentiation of experienced content; no demonstrated separate Gefühl/Empfindung theory requires changing feeling to a bodily sensation here. The guide exposes both words and the contextual variation (F05).

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Lost restriction: 'nur eben jene Allgemeinheit' drops 'nur', and 'welche gerade ... Raum erlaubt' drops 'gerade'.
decision.resolution: Accepted: only and precisely restore the objection’s restrictive formulation.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Gewalt des Menschen über die Sprache' and 'ihre Macht über ihn' both become 'power', and 'Kraft' is also 'power' throughout. The next sentence (p51:s2) opposes 'diese' (Macht, a physiological operation) to 'jene' (Gewalt, a purely dynamic one); the English has to paraphrase the referents because it has no terms left to distinguish them.
decision.resolution: Not adopted as a universal three-term mechanism. The source opposition is between human power over language and language’s power over humans, explicitly repeated in51:s2, not proved to be three mutually exclusive faculties by Gewalt/Macht/Kraft alone. Mastery could overstate control where51 limits freedom. Preserve power, identify each bearer, and expose the German terms in the guide.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: (1) In 'so lassen sich, nur innerhalb eines gewissen Spielraums, ihre Gränzen erkennen' the scope of 'nur innerhalb ...' is ambiguous: it may limit the recognizability of the limits (the English: 'though only within a certain range') or specify the limits themselves (freedom is confined to a certain latitude). (2) 'Spielraum' is 'range' here and 'scope' in p52:s8.
decision.resolution: Partly accepted: latitude is consistent with52. Retain the reading that bounds our recognition of limits, but add a local note giving the alternative that latitude directly bounds freedom. The German comma frame leaves the scope unresolved; a literal English comma frame would hide rather than explain that uncertainty.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Intellectualitaet der Nationen' is rendered 'intellectual orientation', against 'intellectual life' for the same word in p54:s5; 'Spielraum' is 'scope' against 'range' in p51:s4.
decision.resolution: Accepted for consistency: intellectual life in52 and54 retains the same underlying concept; latitude is consistent with51. Intellectuality would be possible but unnecessarily opaque for the intended reader. The guide rules out a modern IQ reading.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Intellectualitaet' is rendered 'intellectual life' (see F55).
decision.resolution: Accepted with F55: intellectual life consistently in both52 and54, retaining the question about approach and specifically through language.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: 'Naturzusammenhang' is rendered 'natural interconnectedness', which hides the opposition to freedom that the sentence states.
decision.resolution: Retained: natural interconnectedness is plain English for the naturally conditioned nexus and its opposition to national/individual freedom is explicit in this very sentence. Nexus of nature would not settle a source ambiguity and is less accessible; no omission of the opposition was demonstrated.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: errathen rendered as infer, strengthening a guessing or divining apprehension into a firmer logical inference and losing the tentative modality.
decision.resolution: Accepted: learn to guess, also addressing ClaudeF09; it does not imply a deductively secure inference or supernatural divination.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Geltung erhalten rendered as become effective, shifting validity or currency in thought toward causal efficacy.
decision.resolution: Accepted: acquire validity replaces become effective, retaining Geltung rather than causal efficacy.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Terminology inconsistency for Stamm: rendered tribe here, but stock or stocks for the same descent and population concept in p29:s5, p29:s6 and p37:s6, without a corresponding German change of term.
decision.resolution: Accepted: stock replaces tribe, also addressing ClaudeF41 and preserving the same grouping label.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: unzeitiger Gleichnisse rendered as inopportune analogies, conflating Gleichnis with the work's separate technical term Analogie.
decision.resolution: Accepted: untimely comparisons replaces inopportune analogies; the by-means clause and no-pretension framing are also restored against the German.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Intellectualitaet rendered as intellectual orientation here but as intellectual life in p54:s5, resetting the same abstract technical term within the same discussion of national individuality.
decision.resolution: Accepted for consistency: intellectual life is used in both52 and54 and explained in the guide; intellectuality is possible but less accessible.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; English and annotation review pending
decision.question: Intellectualitaet rendered as intellectual life here but as intellectual orientation in p52:s8, resetting the same abstract technical term within the same discussion of national individuality.
decision.resolution: Accepted with F5: intellectual life remains consistent across the two passages, without a claim about measured intelligence.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Printed hierarchy and presentation
decision.resolution: Retain the checked Arabic1, not the RomanI introduced by Codex. Darstellung is presentation, as in the earlier heading; do not silently change the level.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Grundzüge and general type
decision.resolution: Use Outlines consistently with the work’s title. Typus concerns the general process pattern, not a morphological language class.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Scope of the printed heading
decision.resolution: Keep language in general, not a claim about a single language.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Interaction without added constituent ontology
decision.resolution: Full interaction preserves Zusammenwirken without adding the base candidate’s explicit parts where the German does not name them.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Provisional organizational deduction
decision.resolution: Keep might follow, the chapter-wide material and at least in outline; do not turn the proposal into an established classification.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Thought and feeling capacity
decision.resolution: Render the coordinated Denk- und Empfindungsvermögen without requiring two separately enumerated faculties.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Historical evaluation
decision.resolution: Mutilated retains verstümmelt rather than silently softening the author’s judgment. The focused sign-language note supplies the modern qualification.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Bodily sensation and expressive feeling
decision.resolution: Sensation fits the animal-cry context; feeling remains appropriate in the wider thought/feeling contrast. No single English equivalent is imposed on every Empfindung.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Wesen in context
decision.resolution: Nature states the character of the thinking process, avoiding a new doctrine introduced by stylistic variation.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Testing intelligibility
decision.resolution: Keep the experimental testing claim without implying a specific chronological experiment before all self-understanding.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Qualification of the singing creature
decision.resolution: Retain the active qualification only one that joins ideas to its tones, within the singing comparison, alongside the qualified historical label and richness assertion.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Ideenlos is not inattentiveness
decision.resolution: Ringing devoid of ideas retains the claimed lack of determinate ideational effect, not an ordinary accusation of careless speech; the following allowance for feeling remains.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Audible identity and classification
decision.resolution: Retain the distinction between increasingly close classification and a language expressing its own singular identity to the ear.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Uncertain printed verb and stock
decision.resolution: The enlarged print confirms ab-schliesst. Brings much to a close leaves completion/closing-off less narrowly decided; both remain possible. Do not silently emend to a wear-away verb. Stock preserves the grouping metaphor without adding a modern genetic theory.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Representing as an activity
decision.resolution: The moving mass is of Vorstellen, not merely a collection of already finished representations.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Shared action through influence
decision.resolution: Keep the compressed causal/shared-action relation; mutual influence is plausible in context but reciprocal direction is not explicit in this phrase.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Common active power in comprehension
decision.resolution: Power of language keeps Sprachkraft consistent; understanding activates inward receptivity, not a passive store of meanings.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Nested determination and inner life
decision.resolution: Keep stock, nation, dialect, established sound signs, use and ultimate individuality as nested or successive determinations; inner life is Gemüth, not a new separate cognitive faculty.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Printed supplementation and the kinship genitive
decision.resolution: Render the printed [zu] as an ordinary English infinitive, recording the supplementation separately. Retain the difficult kinship of human individuality without inventing an independently evidenced metaphysics.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Target of the objection
decision.resolution: This opposite view refers to the first account in34, not the favoured unity of nature. Keep understanding as active awakening of the hearer’s power of language.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Animal sensation and human linguistic power
decision.resolution: The activation contrast is not a denial that even the earliest child may already have linguistic power; preserve the parenthetical qualification.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Growth rather than memorized deposits
decision.resolution: Capacity for language renders Sprachvermögen; the meting-out/deposit/babbling metaphor remains distinct from growth through age and practice.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Direction and strength of the developmental inference
decision.resolution: The observations are offered as evidence of development rather than mechanical learning, not as conclusions proved by it. Preserve the universal timing assertion and qualify it in a sourced note.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Earliest transfer and continued universal capacity
decision.resolution: Restore the mother’s-lap image. The German does not specify a precise measured transfer age; the shared human capacity claim and its contrast with diversification remain.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Stock-like disposition
decision.resolution: Keep the historical claim concerning disposition without translating it into modern genetic terminology.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Predisposition is asserted, not established
decision.resolution: Use they had originally been destined for another language, but this destiny had been accidentally altered. This takes zu einer andren Sprache with Bestimmung; attachment to verrückt, meaning shifted onto another language, remains possible and is disclosed. No named individual case is supplied.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Weltansicht and standpoint
decision.resolution: Keep view of the world recoverable rather than replacing it with an unrelated ideological label. It is a standpoint of subjective apprehension.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Three components of the concept
decision.resolution: Retain impression, subjective reception and the word as speech sound as three contributions. External object clarifies the Gegenstand’s referent here without establishing a global physical-thing/Object ontology.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Both opposed predicates belong to language
decision.resolution: Language itself is object/independent and subject/dependent in precisely the same respect; do not reduce Subject to an English adjective subjective.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Unexpressed noun in many
decision.resolution: Many cases leaves open whether generations or languages supply the ellipsis. Remove merely, which could imply that imperceptibility is the only issue everywhere.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Descent, transformation and author note
decision.resolution: Retain the warning against a language emerging as a separate complete object. The mother language transforms through successive speakers and mixture. Store the original callout after Sprachen and render the full author note separately, not as a raw asterisk in the body.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Distributive language
decision.resolution: Their languages makes clear the two stocks relate to two primordial languages; it does not turn the singular German into a claim of one shared language.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Appositional sounds
decision.resolution: Read als Töne as specifying the means, namely sounds, not an added contrast of language using means as sounds.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Author’s methodological self-check
decision.resolution: Restore the person who risks exaggeration rather than personifying general reasoning as surrendering itself.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Avoid separating individuality and similarity into domains
decision.resolution: The rejection covers the allocation of individuality solely to sound and similarity solely to the ideal sphere; do not imply the second allocation is independently endorsed.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Not-understanding is within understanding
decision.resolution: Retain the parallel formulation; failure to understand might suggest total communicative failure, whereas the following argument treats degrees of divergence.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Intellectualitaet without modern IQ
decision.resolution: Use intellectual life, as in54, for Intellectualitaet; latitude, as in51, for Spielraum. Neither word entails national IQ or a separate measured mechanism.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Dead versus living metaphor
decision.resolution: Retain dead language as the contrast with the living mind and in55. Here dead is inherited material abstracted from living acts, not necessarily an extinct language.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Orientation towards intellectual life
decision.resolution: The pronoun refers to national individuality; preserve both whether/which direction and specifically through language. Intellectual life renders the same German family as52 without introducing measured national intelligence.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Retrospective duality and references
decision.resolution: Keep act/material and natural interconnectedness/freedom distinctions and all printed numeric cross-references, including the overlap at51; no silent correction.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Words and combining into discourse
decision.resolution: Make Redeverbindung intelligible in English while retaining its stated matter/form relation, not forcing a modern syntactic category on the whole term.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Matter/form is not sounds/rules
decision.resolution: Preserve both counterexamples and discourse as purpose; word formation also has rules and connected discourse can employ distinctive sounds.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Compressed coordination and hypothetical origin
decision.resolution: Take intellectual activity as the subject of establishes; articulated sound is the competing grammatical subject. Put the hypothetical beginning with establishment, but disclose the subject and scope alternatives in a local note. Preserve sound becoming articulated sound without a false invariant Ton/Laut equivalence.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Essential nature and preceding logical account
decision.resolution: Supply nature from the preceding clause, but retain the author’s claim of dependence on vibration; do not reconcile it with21 by a distinction absent from the text.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Two announced aspects
decision.resolution: Supply second as English coordination for the twofold announcement; the third higher unity is left unexplained, as in the source.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Wesenheit and a hearer
decision.resolution: Reality, not substantial reality, retains the word’s objective standing through hearing/reply without silently adding material substance.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Pronominal form across languages
decision.resolution: Retain Humboldt’s structural universality claim without translating it as phonetic identity or genealogical proof. The pronouns are I/you/he, with you representing singular Du.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Inclusive origin parenthesis
decision.resolution: Read the uneven nicht … sondern auch inclusively as not just … but also, guided by auch. Disclose the supplied scope; retain the modest inner-conviction framing and the unity-of-nature contrast.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Inca identification limit
decision.resolution: Keep the source’s unspecified language of the Incas and both family/rank associations; do not equate it with a named modern variety without evidence.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Printed pronoun and the overpowered party
decision.resolution: Retain [they] for print-supplied [sie]; the singular participle describes the one party overpowered physically then mentally, not the newly convergent language.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Unity without one primordial language
decision.resolution: The unity is mediated sharing among connected languages; retain the explicit denial that this means one original ancestor.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Hypothesis rather than migration fact
decision.resolution: Preserve the supposition and its consequence: no similarities due to previously formed language under the stipulated absence of contact; do not turn that supposition into established history.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Weltvorstellung differs lexically from Weltansicht
decision.resolution: Use representation of the world for the changed term without manufacturing a fully separate theory.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Admission about demonstration and repeated because
decision.resolution: Retain the inability to demonstrate the whole relation empirically in a particular language, followed by the theoretical and practical reasons; preserve the resumed if-clause readably.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Sounds, not silently words
decision.resolution: The antecedent Laute is retained even though personal dictionary points to word sounds/spoken forms. Record the breadth rather than changing the source noun to words.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Reversed demonstratives and physiological analogy
decision.resolution: Assign physiological operation to language’s power over humans, dynamic operation to human power over language. Keep freedom’s pronoun open at the level of language/its operative powers; the note explains the analogy.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: National aggregate referent
decision.resolution: Take in demselben as in national influence rather than in the individual; disclose the alternative because it changes the account of aggregation.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: Author footnote and printed page brackets
decision.resolution: Translate the complete note, retain the source-supplied [43.] and attribution to Humboldt; no claim that Klaproth’s cited page has been independently checked.

decision.authority: Coordinator under D033; provisional source-based interpretation
decision.question: General type as the comparison point
decision.resolution: The type is the general pattern of the mental process to which individual descriptions must return; it is not a preassigned morphological class. Now avoids adding an explicit therefore inference.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-indian-grammar
decision.resolution: Humboldt is describing the limits of his knowledge, not denying that India had a grammatical tradition. Pāṇini’s *Aṣṭādhyāyī* is a Sanskrit grammatical text; see its [opening rules](https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_z_misc_major_works/aShTAdhyAyI.html?lang=iast). (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-establishment
decision.resolution: The English takes intellectual activity as establishing the domain of sounds. The nearer German subject, articulated sound, is also possible; the hypothetical beginning may qualify that establishment or the whole account of producing articulated sound. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-noise
decision.resolution: “Noise” here means the audible physical component of speech, contrasted with articulation; it need not mean an unwanted or disorderly sound. See the terminology guide on sound and articulation. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-deaf-language
decision.resolution: “Deaf-mute” is Humboldt’s historical label. His account considers lip-reading, writing and taught speech; a natural sign language such as ASL is a complete visual language with its own grammar, not merely a set of signs for spoken sounds. See [NIDCD, American Sign Language](https://www.nidcd.nih.gov/health/american-sign-language), especially “What is ASL?” and “How does ASL compare with spoken language?” (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-articulation-senses
decision.resolution: Passage21 separates articulation from audible noise; here Humboldt nevertheless restricts articulation in its essential nature to hearing. His restriction does not accommodate natural sign languages, whose grammar is expressed visually; see the preceding note on deaf people and language. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-starlight
decision.resolution: Air is needed to carry sound, but light can travel through a vacuum. The image here combines these different kinds of propagation; see [NASA, “Anatomy of an Electromagnetic Wave”](https://science.nasa.gov/ems/02_anatomy/), on mechanical and electromagnetic waves. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-animal-song
decision.resolution: Birds are not the only animals that sing: male humpback whales also produce complex songs. See [NOAA’s account of humpback whale song](https://hawaiihumpbackwhale.noaa.gov/science/research/whale-behavior.html), “Understanding the function of humpback whale song”. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-savages
decision.resolution: “So-called savages” preserves Humboldt’s qualified historical label. His immediate point is that these languages contain expressive resources beyond practical need, rather than being impoverished systems for obtaining help. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-abschliesst
decision.resolution: “Brings much to a close” follows the printed verb *abschliesst*, whose force here is uncertain: it may mean completing or closing off. “Wears much away” would fit the contrast with what remains fixed, but would require a different German reading; the checked print has not been altered. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-inclusive-we
decision.resolution: The distinction is between “we, including you” and “we, excluding you”: often called inclusive and exclusive *we*. Humboldt invokes different grammatical forms for these meanings, without giving a language-specific example here. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-origin-parenthesis
decision.resolution: The English reads the parenthesis as “not just … but also”, including both emergence as such and emergence in each act of speaking. The print has an uneven “not … but also” construction; the inclusive reading follows “also”, but a strictly literal rendering leaves the relation unclear. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-development
decision.resolution: The broad developmental pattern does not warrant the claim about all children under the most varied circumstances. Children differ in timing, and access to language matters; see [NIDCD, “Speech and Language Developmental Milestones”](https://www.nidcd.nih.gov/health/speech-and-language), the opening two sections. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-descent
decision.resolution: The proposed inherited destiny for a particular language is Humboldt’s inference, not something established by the examples offered here. He names no individual case in this passage; attachment to a familiar language does not by itself distinguish inheritance from experience. The German may instead mean that an original destiny was shifted onto another language; distinguish either reading from the descent of languages in43–47. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-inca
decision.resolution: Humboldt gives no name or example that identifies this variety precisely. “The language of the Incas” here should therefore not be silently equated with a particular modern language; the point of the example is its joint association with family descent and social rank. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-klaproth
decision.resolution: Mr Klaproth already makes this observation in *Asia polyglotta*, p. [43.] (Humboldt)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-individuality
decision.resolution: This qualifies the earlier emphasis on sound in29: here individuality extends throughout a language, and50 places “true individuality” in the individual speaker. The changes in level—from a language’s audible identity to its entire character and then its speakers—should remain visible rather than being harmonized into one unchanging claim. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-not-understanding
decision.resolution: The claim concerns differences within understanding, not its complete impossibility: even speakers who agree do not attach precisely identical content to a word. The qualification develops the differences introduced in50 rather than retracting the possibility of communication argued for earlier. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-physiological
decision.resolution: “Physiological” describes language’s inherited power over its users; “dynamic” describes their power to act upon it. Humboldt expressly marks the physiological term as an analogy applied to mental powers, not a claim about a measured bodily mechanism. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-latitude
decision.resolution: The English takes “within a certain latitude” to qualify how far freedom’s limits can be recognized. It may instead describe the latitude within which freedom itself operates;52 uses the same word for the scope left to an individual. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader note: nature-aggregate
decision.resolution: “In that influence” takes the compressed German pronoun to refer to national influence: individual treatments appear there in the aggregate. “In the individual” is grammatically possible, but fits the contrast between collective influence and individual activity less well. (Trans.)

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-general-type
decision.resolution: The shared pattern of the mental process described in16–20, abstracting from circumstances that give particular languages their character. It is not a classification such as “inflecting” or “agglutinating”.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-mind-soul
decision.resolution: This unit uses “mind”, “soul” and “inner life” to keep these recurring German terms recoverable. They overlap in reference; the wording does not impose a system of three separate faculties. The earlier English147 used “mind” for some instances of Seele and remains preserved.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-representation-concept
decision.resolution: A representation is what the mind presents to itself; a concept is its articulated determination in the argument. “Reality” translates Wesenheit where a thought acquires standing as an object for a subject, not necessarily material substance.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-sound-articulation
decision.resolution: Articulation is the shaping of sound into thought-bearing elements and combinations. Ton and Laut overlap and can both require “sound”; “speech sound” marks Laut where useful. Geräusch is “noise” in the specific contrast of21–22, without the implication of unwanted sound. “Alphabet” in29 and33 ranges over speech sounds rather than merely written letters.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-power-capacity
decision.resolution: “Power of language” keeps the recurring Sprachkraft visible; “capacity for language” renders Sprachvermögen. These are contextual contrasts, not names for two independently established mechanisms. Empfindung is “feeling” in the thinking/feeling contrast and “sensation” where bodily or animal responsiveness is at issue. Gewalt and Macht can also require “power”; their German identity remains available in the source. In51 the crucial contrast is who acts upon whom, made explicit in the English, rather than three independently established kinds of mechanism. Gefühl also requires “feeling”; the German words overlap here rather than naming universally separate domains.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-individuality
decision.resolution: Individuality is a distinctive way of being, said of languages, nations and persons at different levels; similarity in kind is what makes them comparable. The bearer and comparison matter. Sound’s privileged role in29 is qualified by49–50, as the local note explains.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-view-world
decision.resolution: Weltansicht in39 is “view of the world”: a standpoint and manner of apprehending things, not merely an explicit set of opinions. Weltvorstellung in49 is “representation of the world”; the English retains the change of German term. This does not by itself make every member of a nation hold identical beliefs;50 explicitly returns to individual differences.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-descent-contact
decision.resolution: Descent may concern people or languages; the argument distinguishes these. “Stock” retains the historical grouping metaphor, including regional groups such as the Florentines in29, without making it a modern biological taxon. “Primordial language” belongs to the explicitly qualified origin discussion in45–47. In43 “mother language” is a supposed parent language; “mother tongues” in49 are people’s native languages.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-speech-discourse
decision.resolution: Rede concerns connected speech or discourse, rather than a stock of words. In55 the distinction is between words as matter and their combination into discourse as form, explicitly not simply sounds versus rules. “Material” renders Stoff where the inherited language is contrasted with its living production. “Dead” material means the inherited stock considered apart from its living use; it need not be an extinct language.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-intellectual
decision.resolution: The repeated Intellectualitaet in52 and54 is “intellectual life”: the sphere towards which national activity is directed, with a role for language. It does not mean measured intelligence or modern national test scores. Geistig and intellectuell can also overlap as “mental” or “intellectual”; the English does not posit two exclusive faculties from that lexical difference.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-nation
decision.resolution: These name the human communities in the argument, not automatically modern sovereign states. Humboldt places dialects, social groups and individual ways of speaking within them, and describes their historical formation through separation and cohesion.

decision.authority: Coordinator applying approved D029 policy under D033; review pending
decision.question: Reader guide: nature-object
decision.resolution: In31 the word is contrasted with things and then becomes an object for a thinking subject;39 distinguishes an external object’s impression from the word’s own effect. “Object” can translate either German noun where the context supports it. Gegenstand does not invariably mean a physical thing:31 also calls I and he different Gegenstände.

evidence.excerpt: Denn es kann im Menschen etwas aufsteigen, dessen Grund kein Verstand in den vorhergehenden Zuständen aufzufinden vermag, und man würde die Natur der Sprache verkennen, und gerade die geschichtliche Wahrheit ihrer Entstehung und Umänderung verletzen, wenn man die Möglichkeit solcher unerklärbaren Erscheinungen von ihr ausschliessen wollte.

evidence.excerpt: In den Sprachen rührt es daher, dass sie unerwartet plötzliche Aufflüge nehmen, und sogar nicht einmal immer allmählich herabsinken, dass an sich gleichartige bei verschiedenen Nationen so verschiedene Behandlung erfahren, dass sie grosse Verschiedenheit des Charakters zeigen, wie z. B. die Griechische und Lateinische, dass einzelne Schriftsteller ganz neue Epochen ihrer Behandlungsart gründen, was auch gewiss schon vor Erfindung der Schrift geschieht, nur da sich für die Nachwelt in Dunkel verliert.

evidence.excerpt: Der Sprachforschung wird diese Rücksicht vorzüglich darum wichtig, darin eine Warnung gegen das Ausreichen bloss mechanischer Erklärungsarten, und gegen das zu grosse Vertrauen auf analytisches Verfahren zu finden.

evidence.excerpt: Die Individualitaet der Nationen kann so mannigfaltige Wege einschlagen, dass jeder Versuch, sie auch nur in Gattungen zu fassen, vergeblich seyn würde.

evidence.excerpt: Aber für die hauptsächlichsten Einwirkungen auf die Sprache kommt es immer nur auf die beiden Punkte an: ob sie sich überhaupt und von welcher Seite aus zur Intellectualitaet, und ob gerade zur Intellectualitaet durch Sprache neigt ?

evidence.excerpt: Denn wie man im täglichen Leben verschiedene Grade und Arten der Sprachbedürftigkeit, des Sprachgefühls, der Sprachbehandlung unter den Menschen antrift, so ist es auch mit den Nationen, und was in der beständigen Fortbildung der Sprachen erscheint, das ist auch bei ihrer Entstehung aus einander geschehen, da diese ja selbst (43.) nur ein allmähliches Anderswerden seyn konnte.

evidence.excerpt: Ueber diese Verschiedenheit der nationellen Aneignung der Sprache liesse sich noch Vieles bemerken, wenn es nicht mein Zweck in diesem Kapitel wäre, um den Bau und das Ineinandergreifen des Ganzen zu zeigen, das Einzelne bloss andeutungsweise zu berühren.

evidence.excerpt: Da wir nunmehr die Sprache überhaupt in ihrer zwiefachen Natur betrachtet haben, als geistigen Act im Sprechen und Verstehen, und als durch diesen erzeugten, todten, zwar nie ausser dem Menschen, aber immer ausser dem Einzelnen vorhandenen Stoff (40 — 54.) , da wir ferner in ihr den Naturzusammenhang (40 — 51.) getrennt haben von der nationellen und individuellen Freiheit (52 — 54.), so gehen wir jetzt zu ihrem Verfahren im Einzelnen über.

evidence.excerpt: In diesem sondern sich nun zwei Dinge deutlich von einander ab, die Wörter und die Redeverbindung, als die Materie und Form der Sprache.

evidence.statement: Relevant complete sections read through web tool Sound requires a material medium; electromagnetic radiation, including light, propagates through a vacuum. The historical reach of Humboldt’s image remains an interpretive question.
